subject: Final invoice handshake — EOT settlement & VAT clarifications
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final invoice handshake — EOT settlement & VAT clarifications

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached is Redwood's final settlement invoice for the end-of-term true-up (attached: Redwood_Invoice_4432_202705.pdf) plus a short workbook that maps credits and prorates to the invoice lines (EOT_settlement_summary_4432.xlsx).

Key asks to keep this moving:
- Please confirm the Aurora PO number (or attach a PO file) so we can mark the invoice as PO-backed.
- Confirm the billing currency (EUR is our default for EU accounts) and whether Aurora will apply reverse-charge or provide a VAT registration certificate. If you plan to reverse-charge, please send the VAT ID/residency cert for our records.
- We can accept a split payment in two tranches (60% / 40%) if you need a short runway — please state the proposed payment dates.

Next steps from our side: if we get the PO + VAT residency confirmation by EOD Tue (25 May), we'll issue a corrected invoice with explicit reverse-charge wording and the two-tranche schedule reflected. Otherwise we'll proceed with the standard invoice terms.

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_4432_202705.pdf (final invoice, PDF), EOT_settlement_summary_4432.xlsx (spreadsheet).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Final invoice handshake — EOT settlement & VAT clarifications

Marissa — thanks for the invoice and the workbook. A few quick questions from our finance team: 

1) Reverse charge / VAT: We plan to reverse-charge but need Redwood to add the standard reverse-charge line and reference our VAT ID on the invoice. I will attach our VAT registration (Ireland) once I have the procurement email thread.

2) Payment split: We can do a two-tranche payment as you suggested but need the first tranche (60%) to be payable 30 days from invoice and the second tranche (40%) at 60 days. Is that acceptable?

3) Currency and bank details: Can you confirm wire instructions and whether the invoice can be issued in EUR? Our AP system requires a PO matched to the invoice; I'll push procurement to issue PO-4432 by Tue.

4) One line item appears to be the prorate credit reversing incorrectly in your workbook — page 2, row 14. Can you confirm that the credit was applied to MRR vs commit?

If you can update the invoice PDF with reverse-charge text and the PO field, we'll expedite PO issuance and provide VAT doc.

Thanks,
Liam
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
Aurora Health
liam.oneill@aurorahealth.com

Team — forwarding Liam's reply. Short internal plan before I send the corrected PDF back to Aurora: 

- Karthik: can you confirm GL / revenue recognition code for the prorate credit reallocation? Liam flagged that the credit may have been applied to MRR versus commit; we'll need to adjust the workbook and line-level mapping so our revenue team posts correctly.

- Vanessa: please prepare a CB (client billing) invoice variant that includes explicit reverse-charge language and a VAT ID field. Also add our bank wiring instructions and an EUR-denominated total (we'll keep base currency USD in our ledger but show EUR for Aurora).

- I propose we accept the 60/40 split with the 30/60-day cadence Liam proposed. We'll mark the invoice with payment schedule and include a short settlement confirmation for signature (DocuSign link). If procurement insists on a PO before payment, we can accept PO-backed invoice as discussed.

Attachments to supply with the outbound: updated invoice PDF, updated EOT workbook (corrected row), PO template to aid procurement.

I'll send the corrected packet once I have the GL code and the updated PDF.

Thanks,
Marissa
